authority: Jordan: yep brief it and get a coder on it. Relayed by Main.
goal: Implement only a bounded optional Pij state identity resolver, consumed later by PM through existing source/query handling.
owned_paths: crates/loader-query/Cargo.toml: add existing workspace serde_json under dependencies only

interface.function: pub fn resolve_pij(executable: Option<&std::path::Path>, id: &str, limits: PijLookupLimits) -> Result<ResolvedPijSession, PijLookupError>
interface.limits: PijLookupLimits { pub max_output_bytes: usize, pub timeout: std::time::Duration }; bounded defaults and invalid-limit rejection
interface.success: ResolvedPijSession { pub pij_id: String, pub harness: unisphere_core::query::HarnessId, pub native_session_id: String, pub cwd: Option<std::path::PathBuf>, pub machine: Option<String> }
interface.failure: A payload-free typed PijLookupError distinguishes missing executable, lookup unavailable/daemon failure, unknown seat, known seat with no native session, unsupported harness/platform, invalid response/input, output limit, and timeout. Static safe Display/code methods if useful; never raw stdout/stderr/path text in errors.

requirements: Read copied Main implementation/requirements briefs before coding. C10 wire discipline.

Call only the explicitly supplied executable with argv state <id> --json; no shell, lookup retries, list/history fallback, daemon start/revive/install, private-store/registry reads, remote fetch, or cache. Preserve ordinary Pij CLI address/auth mechanics.

Validate required typed fields, exact returned data.id binding, and nonempty native session. Ignore lifecycle/PID/pane/status for identity; tombstones are usable. Keep cwd/machine as hints, never turn them into automatic source reads.

Bound execution time and retained output; discard private diagnostic payloads. Retain crate forbid(unsafe_code). Prefer existing std/dependencies; report any genuinely necessary dependency before adding it.
Each call reads current mapping anew; returned object is the operation snapshot. PM owns pinning through actual query/cursor and native transcript resolution.

Keep focused tests for real process execution: live/tombstoned success, changed mapping, unknown/null/malformed identity, required field mismatch, missing/unavailable executable/daemon, output/time bounds, supported harness mapping. Synthetic IDs only. Native transcript/ordinary no-Pij/CLI stream proof are PM integration scope.
Export the module through lib.rs; no test-only #[path] mounting. Do not alter any other lib.rs body.
SKIP ALL startup boot/build/test/lint/formatters while concurrent owners edit. PM validates the composition once.
Commit candidate through harness commit with native pij commit trailers; preserve actual attribution outcome. Return source/commit(s), paths, interface, unrun checks and limits.
first_action: After reading your native packet and observing actual cwd/branch/head and exposed model/effort, send PM a received/started acknowledgment. Then implement the granted resolver scope without another permission loop. Do not fabricate provider attestation or Builder receipts.
delivery: Write .harness/temp/pij-resolver-delivery.json as ProductOnlyDelivery with unit_id=plan015-pij-session-resolution; explicitly not a sealed plan015 roster delivery or formal Builder allocation.
